tier_reason: Independent full client, richest single surface of any SDK today (attachments, conversation assignment, widget CRUD).
last_verified_by: contract audit: every SDK path diffed against server routes + gateway map, plus per-SDK wire tests

auth.evidence: dotnet/Erghi.SDK/Resources/AuthResource.cs:26-89 -- 2026-10-12: auth now targets the real GoTrue routes behind /api/auth/* (/token, /user, /recover, /verify) and maps its snake_case session; earlier refresh/me/password-reset paths did not exist on the platform.

chat.evidence: dotnet/Erghi.SDK/Resources/ChatResource.cs:29-118, plus SendMessageWithAttachmentAsync (line 95) and AssignConversationAsync (line 66) that no other SDK has.

widgets.evidence: dotnet/Erghi.SDK/Resources/ChatResource.cs:126-140 -- Get/List/Create; no UpdateWidgetAsync (angular has this, dotnet doesn't -- a real cross-SDK gap worth closing).

notes: Has attachment support and conversation assignment that nothing else has -- worth checking whether those are actually used by a real customer before treating their absence elsewhere as urgent debt, rather than assuming dotnet is just 'ahead' by default. UpdateWidgetAsync gap vs angular is small and cheap to close.
